vLLM streaming script in the repository

voice.input_audio: Text with inline emotion tags, preceded by a voice description inside a description wrapper in the prompt [hf-maya1]
voice.output_audio: 24 kHz audio decoded from SNAC codes at about 0.98 kbps; streaming with vLLM [hf-maya1]
voice.voices: voice design from a description; no preset voices and no cloning documented [hf-maya1]
voice.interruption: Not a conversation model: the client stops playback
voice.latency: Maya Research states sub-100 ms latency for real-time use with vLLM; the page gives no test set or hardware for it [hf-maya1]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Open weights, free under Apache-2.0. A single GPU with 16 GB or more is advised: A100, H100 or RTX 4090 [hf-maya1]
